entries.description: For each tool, the first line of every rendered role file is ---, and its frontmatter parses with name and description set.
Read-only roles render with readonly: true for Cursor, and with no Edit, Write or Bash tools for Claude Code.
./verify.sh --render --check passes after a fresh render.
Both checker roles exist with frontmatter name, description, tier deep and tools read, and both render for Cursor and Claude.
Severity category check-weakened is P0 in harness.yaml.
A fixture diff that deletes a test makes the integrity-checker prompt fixture expect check-weakened.
A write on a protected check path is refused unless explicitCheckEdit is set.
Shell commands that skip hooks are refused.
check-integrity fails a deleted test, a skipped test, a suppression, or a sensor edit without an instruction record.
check-integrity is a blocking turn sensor for local and ci.
An auth path marks the unit needs-human and the loop moves on.
A DROP TABLE diff sets humanReview required on a passing report.
A required human review cannot be cleared by a later none.
Each finished wave writes a retro with a deterministic section and a proposal section.
The same wave inputs produce the same retro text.
Retro generation writes only under harness/retro.
Missing work exits 0 as nothing-to-do. A done loop with an empty staged diff exits 1.
An empty turn diff reports status no-changes and changes 0.
Three mutation survivors on one line become one mutant-survived finding.
Survivor findings are capped at 7 times the changed-file count.
The mutation sensor stays non-blocking and ci-only unless mutation.local is true.
A search for the retired host name finds only the two historical ADRs.
Config that names the retired host exits 2 with the fixed error.
CI still runs npm test and verify.sh.
fix-an-escape interviews, proves a regression, and records ESC-NN.
Acceptance ids accept ESC-NN beside A-NN.
The review report lists findings, outcomes, cycles, needs-human, unclosable, and check refusals.
Inferred review outcomes are marked estimated. Escape rate stays out of scope.
The same P1 finding blocks, is backlogged, or is shadow-only depending on review mode.
Existing roles default to blocking. An unlisted role defaults to shadow.
The audit sensor is blocking, stays CI-only, and fails a high advisory fixture.
PRD, ADR, endpoint, and consumer skills interview one question at a time before writing.
Rewritten skill bodies stay under 500 lines.
Every course-map link resolves, and failure modes cover silent no-op, check edits, and human-required paths.
